intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer a {{course}} in {{cityA}}, and both have NIRF 2025 Architecture ranks in our table. This page compares those ranks and the recorded fees we hold, using official sites opened in {{year}}.
BMS College of Architecture vs MSRIT is a rank-and-fee comparison with a gap: BMS has no M.Arch fee or placement row here, while MSRIT has a recorded year total of ₹1,28,780.

sections.heading: BMS College of Architecture vs MSRIT for M.Arch: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose BMS College of Architecture if the better NIRF 2025 Architecture rank of 20 is the priority, after you get the official M.Arch fee from the college, which is missing from our table.
Choose MSRIT if you want a recorded year total of ₹1,28,780 and can accept a NIRF 2025 Architecture rank of 31, after you confirm the official notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: BMS College of Architecture has no M.Arch fee row in our table. A blank cell is not a free degree. Use the official fee notice on bmsca.org.
For MSRIT we hold ₹1,28,780 as a Total Fees year figure for the Master of Architecture. That is a year amount, not a confirmed two-year official total.
Do not invent a BMS fee by guessing from undergraduate architecture figures. Confirm both official notices before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no M.Arch placement row for either campus, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Ask both placement or alumni offices for a recent M.Arch report. Architecture outcomes often include practice and further study, not only a campus package.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official M.Arch admissions note, including any postgraduate architecture test or counselling process.
Our records list NIRF 2025 Architecture ranks of 20 for BMS College of Architecture, up from 23 in 2024, and 31 for MSRIT, which was 21 in 2024. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, so a local student can visit the studios on the same trip.
BMS College of Architecture is a specialist architecture campus. MSRIT is a wider technical institute that also lists an M.Arch. The studio culture may differ.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick BMS College of Architecture if the NIRF 2025 Architecture rank of 20 is the deciding factor, and you have the official fee in hand.
Pick MSRIT if the recorded year total of ₹1,28,780 and that campus fit your plan, with a NIRF 2025 Architecture rank of 31.
Because placements are missing, let rank, studio fit and the official fee decide this comparison.

faqs.question: What NIRF 2025 Architecture ranks are listed?
faqs.answer: BMS College of Architecture is listed at 20, and MSRIT at 31. In 2024 the same list had BMS at 23 and MSRIT at 21. Confirm the official NIRF table if you need the exact listing.

faqs.question: What M.Arch fees are on record?
faqs.answer: BMS has no M.Arch fee row here. MSRIT has a Total Fees year figure of ₹1,28,780, which is not a confirmed two-year official total. Check both official notices.

faqs.question: Are M.Arch placements available?
faqs.answer: No. We have no M.Arch placement row for either campus. Ask the colleges for a recent official report.

faqs.question: Is an entrance exam listed?
faqs.answer: No exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official M.Arch admissions process.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka.

faqs.question: Which college has the better NIRF Architecture rank in 2025?
faqs.answer: On our records, BMS College of Architecture is ahead, at 20, compared with MSRIT at 31. Rank is only one part of the decision, especially while the BMS fee is missing.
